summary: Verified #7 Starter Kit LIVE payment gating and #10 booking accept race safety. All 4 backend gating tests pass. Frontend code inspection confirms /mock is not on the live path; Pro tag is only granted after /verify. Frontend UI reachability of the Starter Kit page could not be exercised in an approved-partner session (fresh demo partners land on profile-completion), but backend gating fully covers the security-critical assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: starter_kit_service.purchase_order (line 279-292): Correctly returns real order when payment_service.is_configured() returns keys (mock:false). Verified live: order_id=order_TZXCahEyd8Hefl, key_id=rzp_live_..., amount=99900 paise (₹999).
starter_kit_service.purchase_mock (line 295-303): Correctly rejects with HTTP 400 'Live payments enabled — use the payment gateway' when payment_service.is_configured() is True. Verified live.

starter_kit_service.purchase_verify (line 306-315): Signature is validated by payment_service.verify_signature BEFORE _activate is called. Bad signature returns 400 and never touches user record. Verified live: purchased state unchanged after bad-signature call.

starter_kit_service._activate (line 174-216): This is the ONLY code path that sets premium_partner=True + partner_badge and inserts starter_kit_purchases. It is called by (a) purchase_order when amount<=0 (free kit — not applicable in prod, price=999), (b) purchase_mock (blocked in live mode), and (c) purchase_verify (only after razorpay verify_payment_signature passes). Pro tag is therefore tied to verified payment in live mode.

booking_controller.accept_job (line 1592-1606): Atomic update {status:'searching'}->{status:'assigned'} with res.modified_count!=1 -> HTTPException 400 'Job no longer available'. This provides the correct optimistic-concurrency guard — only ONE partner can win the race. Confirmed via API: a second accept on an already-assigned booking returns 400 with the expected message.

PartnerStarterKit.jsx (line 26-56): Live-payment path calls /starter-kit/order → openCheckout → onVerify → /starter-kit/verify. /mock is ONLY called when the server explicitly returns order.mock===true (i.e. when live payments are NOT configured — which the backend blocks in prod). If Razorpay checkout is cancelled/failed, openCheckout returns falsy and the code short-circuits before any toast/refresh — no Pro tag granted.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded users and bookings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_starter_kit_and_accept_race.py — reuse as regression. The critical GATING is fully verified server-side; the frontend code path was confirmed by inspection.
